## JSON reference

Inputs, slots, and events come from `@viewstem/ui/support.json`. Omitted inputs use renderer defaults.

### `shadcn.Typography`

| Input | JSON type |
| --- | --- |
| `as` | `"h1" \| "h2" \| "h3" \| "h4" \| "h5" \| "h6" \| "p" \| "blockquote" \| "code" \| "span" \| "small" \| "strong" \| "em" \| "div"` |
| `text` | `string` |
| `variant` | `"h1" \| "h2" \| "h3" \| "h4" \| "p" \| "blockquote" \| "code" \| "lead" \| "large" \| "small" \| "muted"` |
